name: Auckland Zoo Conservation Fund Small Grants Programme
summary: Small annual grants for ongoing or pilot field conservation projects in New Zealand or developing countries; applicants can be based anywhere and the grant must cover at least a quarter of the project budget.

geography.label: New Zealand or a developing country

status.quote: Applications have now closed. Check back later in the year for details on the next round of funding.

geography.quote: Be based in New Zealand or in a developing country (although applicants can be based anywhere in the world)

access.quote: Download, complete and return the Small Grants Programme application form.

window.quote: There is one round of the Small Grants Programme each year.

amount.quote: Small grants will be awarded up to a maximum of NZD$10,000.
